shortDescription: Manage an ACL for a Hyperledger Fabric channel

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the ACL to add, update, or remove from the channel.

options.name: path
options.description: Path to current the channel configuration file. This file can be fetched by using the M(channel_config) module. This file will be updated in place. You will need to keep a copy of the original file for computing the configuration update.

options.name: policy
options.description: The name of the policy used by the ACL.

options.name: state
options.description: C(absent) - An ACL matching the specified name will be removed from the channel. C(present) - Asserts that an ACL matching the specified name and policy exists in the channel. If no ACL matches the specified name, the ACL will be added to the channel. If an ACL matches the specified name but the policy does not match, then the ACL in the channel will be updated.
